methodological_rigor.justification: Limited methodological information from abstract suggests observational case series or small cohort without control group, matching, or explicit confounding control. Retrospective design inherent selection bias. Statistical approach not detailed. Power assessment absent.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Case series or observational study on clinical outcomes. Maps to LoE 4 per Oxford CEBM. Limited actionability without intervention or causal evidence.

reporting_quality.justification: Minimal data sharing disclosure, no protocol registration, limited methodology transparency.

novelty_literature.justification: Appears to document established clinical patterns without novel discovery.

writing_presentation.justification: Limited clarity and organization evident in abstract; methodological precision lacking.

chief_reviewer.rationale: Small case series with very limited methodological rigor. Below tier-4 publication threshold. Recommend reject pending substantial improvements in study design, analytical controls, and reporting transparency.
